settings.hero_body: Some gestures do not need a big occasion. A set of eight soft, colorful companions can be a thoughtful way to say you are thinking of someone.
settings.detail_title: Eight designs, down to the details.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_title: Say hello with a little company.
settings.final_body: Choose the complete eight for someone you would like to keep close in thought.
settings.moods_title: A little company in every color.
settings.moods_body: Every pictured companion is included in the complete set.
settings.personality_title: Keep the gesture simple and personal.
settings.personality_body: Choose the crew because it suits the person you have in mind. Add a note in your own words; the plushes are the gift, and your message makes it yours.
settings.hand_note: Eight companions. Every pictured design included.
settings.personality_eyebrow: Keep the gesture simple and personal.
